## A3. BD panel columns (inhibitor slowdown caused by each app)

**BD feature definitions (confirmed by the chapter director 2026-11-22).** The inhibitor runs for a fixed duration (-r), so its slowdown is its time per unit of work, co-run vs isolated, ratio of aggregate means, no JMs correction on the inhibitor side (S2: inhibitor socket effect ~0):

- MPI timer: c_mpi = ln[(T_MPI / bytes sent)_co / (T_MPI / bytes sent)_iso]  (MPI time per byte)
- app timer: c_tt = ln[(T_app / messages sent)_co / (T_app / messages sent)_iso]  (app time per message)

c_mpi = ln[(T_MPI/bytes)_co/(T_MPI/bytes)_iso] (inhibitor side): finite for 90/90; BD snapshot inhib_bw_mpi_valid 90/90; max |mine - BD| 3.8e-15
c_tt = ln[(T_app/msgs)_co/(T_app/msgs)_iso]: finite for 90/90; BD-TT snapshot inhib_msg_wall_valid 90/90; max |mine - BD| 3.3e-15

|  | min | 50% | mean | max |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| c_mpi | -1.0221 | 0.2647 | 0.2965 | 1.6685 |
| c_tt | -0.0790 | 0.0133 | 0.0267 | 0.2221 |

## A1. Row counts

App-App: 55 unordered co-runs (45 non-self + 10 self) = 100 directed outcomes (90 non-self + 10 self).
Socket-resolved rows: 166 non-self cells (s_V=0: 83, s_V=1: 83; one-rep cells 42) + 10 self rows (s_V = 0.5, pooled copies) = 176 rows.
Resolved cells per non-self unordered pair: {2: 7, 4: 38} (2 = all 4 reps had the same assignment).
Panel: 90 app x config cells; resolved by app socket 169 (one-rep cells 47).
